controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-zeek.connection-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-18T07:17:07.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-18T08:17:07.500Z"
| WHERE source.ip == "172.18.0.15" OR destination.ip == "172.18.0.15"
| STATS conns = COUNT(*), bytes_out = SUM(source.bytes), bytes_in = SUM(destination.bytes), dest_ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(destination.ip), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY destination.ip, destination.port
| SORT conns DESC
| LIMIT 1000
